VBO:0200825.summary: Affectionate and sociable on neighborhood walks, adult Lhasa-Poo Duffer gives a personal glimpse of this Lhasa Apso–Poodle cross. His owner describes meeting neighborhood dog friends and a love of petting and lap time. He is also vocal about daily routines: he alerts her to visitors and passersby, and barks when he wants permission to climb onto a lap or the foot of her bed.
VBO:0200825.shortDescription: A Lhasa Apso–Poodle cross; adult Duffer enjoys neighborhood dog friends, petting and vocal reminders of daily routines.
